subtitle: Sieges, Sutras and the Shadow of a Revolt

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of a battlefield horizon
panels.action: Pushyamitra Shunga stands in war chariot armor, one hand on a sheathed sword, behind him faint silhouettes of Indo-Greek horsemen and distant stupas under storm clouds on the Gangetic plain.

dialogue.text: In the age of collapsing Mauryas and advancing Yavanas, Pushyamitra Shunga’s rise left verses, sieges and accusations that still divide how we read India’s ancient wars.

i18n.hi: टूटते मौर्य और बढ़ते यवनों के बीच, पुष्यिमित्र शुंग का उभार ऐसे श्लोक, घेरे और आरोप छोड़ गया जो आज भी प्राचीन युद्धों को लेकर हमें बांटते हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in over a crumbling palace complex
panels.action: An abandoned royal hall in Pataliputra, pillars cracked and weeds between stone slabs, the Ganga glinting beyond under a hazy sky.

dialogue.text: Around 185 BCE, the old Mauryan capital of Pataliputra stood tired and heavy, its empire frayed, its court whispered to be weak under the last king, Brihadratha.

i18n.hi: लगभग 185 ईसा पूर्व, पुरानी मौर्य राजधानी पाटलिपुत्र थकी हुई खड़ी थी, साम्राज्य ढीला, दरबार में फुसफुसाहट कि अंतिम राजा बृहद्रथ कमजोर हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot in a dim court hall
panels.action: Pushyamitra Shunga, middle-aged, stern, in general’s attire, stands at the edge of a hall, watching a distracted Brihadratha in the distance practicing mock drills with soldiers.

dialogue.text: Tradition remembers Pushyamitra as the Mauryan senapati, a Shunga general who watched the old order stumble while frontiers burned and rivals circled.

i18n.hi: परंपरा में पुष्यिमित्र को मौर्य सेनापति कहा गया, शुंग सेनानायक जिसने देखा कि पुरानी व्यवस्था लड़खड़ा रही है, जबकि सीमाएं जल रही हैं और दुश्मन घेर रहे हैं।

panels.shot: high-angle wide of a frontier landscape
panels.action: A vast northern frontier: ridges, river crossings, distant fort-towns, and on the far horizon a compact line of foreign-looking cavalry with crested helmets approaching.

dialogue.text: To the northwest, beyond the Indus, new powers rose. Later texts call them Yavanas, Greeks from the fractured Hellenistic world pressing towards the plains.

i18n.hi: उत्तर-पश्चिम में, सिंधु के पार नई शक्तियाँ उठीं। बाद के ग्रंथ उन्हें यवन कहते हैं, बिखरी यूनानी दुनिया से आए राजा जो मैदानों की ओर बढ़ रहे थे।

panels.shot: intimate interior with scholar at work
panels.action: A grammarian, representing Patanjali, sits in a simple hut, palm-leaf manuscript before him, lips forming example sentences as he writes by the light of a small oil lamp.

dialogue.text: Near this troubled time, the scholar Patanjali composed his Mahabhashya, and in dry examples he dropped a jarring glimpse of war.

i18n.hi: इसी उथल-पुथल के समय में पाणिनि के परंपरागत व्याख्याकार पतंजलि ने महाभाष्य लिखा, और सूखे उदाहरणों के बीच अचानक युद्ध की झलक डाल दी।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on the stylus over palm leaf
panels.action: The stylus hovers over a palm leaf, inscribing Prakrit words that mention a Yavana army and named cities like Saketa and Madhyamika.

dialogue.text: He spoke of Yavanas laying siege to Saketa and Madhyamika, turning grammar exercises into some of our sharpest evidence for Greek pressure on the Ganga routes.

i18n.hi: वह यवनों के सकेत और मध्यमिक पर घेरा डालने की बात करता है, व्याकरण की कसरतों को गंगा मार्गों पर यूनानी दबाव के तेज सबूत में बदल देता है।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-shot in a war council tent
panels.action: Pushyamitra stands over a floor map, markers showing Pataliputra, Saketa and western approaches; officers around him look tense as he listens, hand on chin.

dialogue.text: This was the world in which Pushyamitra moved: eastward, a fading court; westward, Yavana thrusts; between them, old allies and rivals weighing whom to back.

i18n.hi: यही वह दुनिया थी जिसमें पुष्यिमित्र चलते थे: पूरब में ढलता दरबार, पश्चिम में यवनों की धक्कामुक्की, और बीच में पुराने साथी-दुश्मन तय करते कि किसका साथ दें।

panels.shot: low-angle close-up in a crowded royal assembly
panels.action: In a ceremonial field, Brihadratha inspects troops with relaxed ease while behind him Pushyamitra’s eyes narrow, jaw set, hand quietly signaling to hidden guards.

dialogue.text: Later Puranic tradition says that on a parade ground, Pushyamitra struck down Brihadratha and took the throne, ending the Mauryas in a sudden coup.

i18n.hi: बाद की पुराण परंपरा कहती है कि सेना की परेड में ही पुष्यिमित्र ने बृहद्रथ को मार गिराया और गद्दी छीन ली, मौर्यों को एक अचानक साजिश में खत्म कर दिया।

panels.shot: wide shot of coronation amidst wary nobles
panels.action: Pushyamitra sits on a simple throne in Pataliputra, crown newly placed, while some courtiers bow deeply and others stand stiff, exchanging uncertain glances.

dialogue.text: The Shunga dynasty began in this atmosphere of force and doubt, its first king a general who knew his hold rested on fragile loyalties and looming enemies.

i18n.hi: शुंग वंश इस बल और संदेह के माहौल में शुरू हुआ, पहला राजा वह सेनापति जो जानता था कि उसकी सत्ता कमजोर वफादारियों और मंडराते दुश्मनों पर टिकी है।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye over marching armies near a city wall
panels.action: An army under Pushyamitra advances towards a city with high walls, banners fluttering; on the opposite ramparts faint figures stand in foreign armor, watching.

dialogue.text: In the north-west and central India, Indo-Greek kings like Demetrios and their successors pushed in; traditions like the Yuga Purana remember stormy Yavana campaigns against Indian cities.

i18n.hi: उत्तर-पश्चिम और मध्य भारत में, डेमेत्रियस जैसे इंडो-ग्रीक राजा और उनके उत्तराधिकारी धकेलते आए; युगपुराण जैसे ग्रंथ भारतीय नगरों पर यवनों के तूफानी अभियानों को याद रखते हैं।

panels.shot: dramatic wide of besieged city Saketa
panels.action: The city of Saketa under siege: ladders against walls, defenders bracing, foreign cavalry waiting below, while the countryside beyond lies trampled.

dialogue.text: Patanjali’s terse examples point to sieges at Saketa and Madhyamika, suggesting that, during Pushyamitra’s early reign, Yavana armies tested the heartland’s defenses.

i18n.hi: पतंजलि के छोटे-से उदाहरण सकेत और मध्यमिक के घेरे की ओर इशारा करते हैं, मानो पुष्यिमित्र के शुरुआती राजकाल में ही यवन सेनाएँ मध्यभूमि की दीवारें टटोल रही थीं।

panels.shot: medium shot on city ramparts at dawn
panels.action: Pushyamitra stands atop a fortified wall at dawn, looking west toward a departing, dust-raising army, his face lined with exhaustion and wary relief.

dialogue.text: The details are sparse. The Mahabhashya does not name Shungas, but its grammar hints that some Yavana assaults were beaten back, not triumphant marches deep into Magadha.

i18n.hi: बारीक बातें कम हैं। महाभाष्य शुंगों का नाम नहीं लेता, पर व्याकरण से झलकता है कि कुछ यवन हमले लौटाए गए, वे मगध के दिल तक विजयी मार्च नहीं थे।

panels.shot: interior of a Buddhist monastery hall
panels.action: Inside a quiet monastery, monks sit in rows under a painted ceiling, a senior elder reading from a manuscript as younger novices listen with grave faces.

dialogue.text: Far from court, another record took shape. In Buddhist circles, stories circulated about the fall of the Mauryas and the new king who followed.

i18n.hi: दरबार से दूर एक और कथा बन रही थी। बौद्ध संघों में मौर्यों के पतन और नए राजा की बातें घूम रहीं थीं।

panels.shot: close-up of a monk narrating to disciples
panels.action: An elder monk, representing the Ashokavadana tradition, leans forward as he narrates, his listeners shocked, hands at their mouths as they imagine violence.

dialogue.text: The Ashokavadana, preserved in the Divyavadana, tells how Pushyamitra destroyed monasteries, toppled stupas and announced a reward of a hundred dinaras for the head of a shramana.

i18n.hi: दिव्यावदान में सुरक्षित अशोकावदान बताता है कि पुष्यिमित्र ने विहार तोड़े, स्तूप गिराए और श्रमण का सिर लाने पर सौ दीनार का इनाम घोषित किया।

panels.shot: somber mid-shot of ruined sanctuary
panels.action: A broken shrine hall with fallen roof beams and scattered statues lies abandoned, overgrown with grass, a single monk standing at the edge in silent shock.

dialogue.text: These texts describe shrines burnt, monasteries razed and monks killed or scattered, painting Pushyamitra as a persecutor and breaker of the Buddha’s legacy.

i18n.hi: ये ग्रंथ जलते मंदिरों, उजड़े विहारों और मारे या बिखरे भिक्षुओं की तस्वीर खींचते हैं, पुष्यिमित्र को बुद्ध की धरोहर का दुश्मन और तोड़नेवाला बनाते हैं।

panels.shot: split-composition wide of multiple stupas under construction
panels.action: An expansive view of Sanchi-like stupas in mid-construction, scaffolds up, artisans carving railings and donors approaching with offerings, under a clear Shunga-era sky.

dialogue.text: Yet spades in the ground tell another part of the story. At Sanchi and other sites, archaeology shows many stupas expanded and embellished during the very centuries of Shunga rule.

i18n.hi: पर जमीन खोदने पर कहानी का दूसरा सिरा निकलता है। सांची आदि जगहों पर खुदाइयों से पता चलता है कि कई स्तूप इन्हीं शुंग सदियों में बढ़ाए और सजाए गए।

panels.shot: close-up on a stone railing with inscription
panels.action: A craftsman’s hand brushes dust from a newly carved rail post, revealing a Prakrit inscription naming local donors, with a faint Shunga-period motif on the stone.

dialogue.text: Scholars like Etienne Lamotte and Romila Thapar note this growth and caution that sweeping tales of a kingdom-wide Buddhist destruction go beyond what the material record supports.

i18n.hi: एतियेन लामोत्ते और रोमिला थापर जैसे विद्वान इस बढ़त को देखते हैं और चेतावनी देते हैं कि पूरे राज्य भर में बौद्ध संहार की बातें साक्ष्यों से आगे निकल जाती हैं।

panels.shot: introspective mid-shot of a modern historian in a study
panels.action: A modern historian in a book-lined study compares a palm-leaf manuscript and a site plan, a map of ancient India pinned behind, marked with routes and sites.

dialogue.text: They weigh the partisan tone of the Ashokavadana, likely shaped in later Buddhist debates, against inscriptions, coins and ruins that reveal both conflict and continuity.

i18n.hi: वे अशोकावदान की पक्षपाती भाषा, जो बाद की बौद्ध बहसों में घड़ी गई लगती है, को अभिलेखों, सिक्कों और खंडहरों के साथ तौलते हैं जो साथ-साथ टकराव और निरंतरता दोनों दिखाते हैं।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Pushyamitra at a sacrificial altar
panels.action: Pushyamitra presides at a Vedic-style sacrificial altar, priests around him, while beyond the ritual ground a distant stupa rises on a hill, barely visible through heat-haze.

dialogue.text: Traditional accounts also portray Pushyamitra reviving Brahmanical rites, yet the same landscape held active monasteries, suggesting a patchwork of rivalry, patronage and local politics.

i18n.hi: पुरानी कथाएँ पुष्यिमित्र को ब्राह्मणीय यज्ञों का पुनरुद्धारक भी मानती हैं, पर वही भूभाग सक्रिय विहारों से भरा था, जैसे कहीं rivalry, कहीं संरक्षण, कहीं स्थानीय राजनीति की चितकबरी तस्वीर।

panels.shot: wide shot of Indo-Greek and Shunga frontiers on a map
panels.action: A stylized map of northern India shows Shunga domains and Indo-Greek territories side by side, arrows indicating campaigns, key cities like Mathura and Saketa glowing softly.

dialogue.text: The Yavana wars and Shunga rule left a checkerboard frontier: Indo-Greek kings held parts of the northwest, while Shunga authority, often contested, stretched over the Ganga heartland.

i18n.hi: यवन युद्ध और शुंग राज ने एक चौखानेदार सरहद छोड़ी: उत्तर-पश्चिम में इंडो-ग्रीक राजा, और गंगा की मध्यभूमि पर अक्सर चुनौती झेलती शुंग सत्ता।

panels.shot: concluding slow pull-back over layered texts and ruins
panels.action: On a stone floor lie a copy of Patanjali’s treatise, the Ashokavadana manuscript, a Shunga coin and a plan of Sanchi, all lit by slanting evening light from a nearby ruined arch.

dialogue.text: In Pushyamitra’s shadow, grammar, prophecy and stone disagree; his age reminds us that hard claims must be spoken clearly, but their weight tested patiently against every trace the past has left.

i18n.hi: पुष्यिमित्र की छाया में व्याकरण, भविष्यवाणी और पत्थर सब अलग बोलते हैं; उनका युग याद दिलाता है कि बातें चाहे साफ कहो, पर उनका वजन हर उस निशान से तौलना पड़ता है जो अतीत ने छोड़ा है।

subtitle_i18n.en: Sieges, Sutras and the Shadow of a Revolt
subtitle_i18n.hi: घेरा, सूत्र और बगावत की छाया
